newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - JAN 6.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - JAN 6.

text.p: These are the main headlines on Hungary's Kossuth Radio midday news. Reuters cannot vouch for their accuracy:
- Hungarian Foreign Minister Laszlo Kovacs, visiting to Israel, will meet Yasser Arafat today.
- One of the most influential Bucharest newspapers made a savage onslaught on the Romanian foreign minister for its negotiations and agreements concluded in Budapest.
- The letter of President Arpad Goncz to National Assembly Chairman Zoltan Gal, detailing the reasons for which Goncz returned the conflict of interest bill to the Parliament, has been published.
- The Military Attorney Office of Budapest said that the irregular registers of the II. district police made the investigation in the case of nine stole submachine-guns difficult.
